notes: Genesis Agents (GENESIS): fixed supply of 1,000,000,000 tokens (1e27 minor units, 18 decimals) minted once to the deployer (the launch factory) in a no-argument constructor. No owner, no admin, no mint, no burn, no fee, no tax, no limit; plain ERC-20 transfers. No proxy, delegatecall or selfdestruct. The factory sends the swarm's 10% to the Merkle distributor, seeds the Uniswap v4 pool (PoolManager 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90) with 90% paired with IMD, and forwards any remainder to 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead. pool.initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and the deployed currency order.
